Opening hours and staffing arrangements also changed during the period, so the authors advise against drawing a simple causal conclusion.

back_text: 没有。报告只展示相反趋势，同时还有其他变化。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: provided that 后要求目标实验室有获批的存储设施；must also 再加一项：离开前登记转移。两项都满足，才可把样本带离现场。

Permission to enter the building does not by itself authorise the removal of materials, so both requirements should be checked in advance.

back_text: 目标实验室有合格存储设施，并在离开前登记转移。

back_text: 不保证。培训是被考虑的必要条件，还需评估经验和空缺。
